title: Bengaluru local route dataset source package
attribution: Geographic data © OpenStreetMap contributors; PBF extraction service BBBike; local routing OSRM Backend.
scope: Complete route datasets and a direct checksum-verified original PBF download, offered on applicable ODbL terms. Pinned graph-regeneration instructions are in docs/LOCAL_OSRM_REPRODUCTION.md; no intermediate graph is distributed or claimed legally exempt.

metadata.source: Independently generated using local OSRM Docker and a BBBike OpenStreetMap extract.
metadata.attribution: Road source data: © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0; extract supplied by BBBike. Routing software: OSRM Backend, run locally in Docker.
metadata.license: ODbL-1.0 (underlying OpenStreetMap data; not an application source-code license)
metadata.redistributionStatus: Public distribution requirements for this OSM-derived fixture and extract must be reviewed; this snapshot does not establish legal clearance or additional permissions.
metadata.waypointNotes: Synthetic original coordinates are retained; snapped points are route endpoints. Snap distances use haversine distance with mean Earth radius 6371008.8 m. No waypoint road names are asserted.
metadata.verification: Candidate coordinates preserved exactly in order; two connected LineString legs and all three waypoint endpoints validated. OSRM distances and durations copied only from the local candidate. No maneuver, node-annotation, or raw-response verification is asserted.
metadata.durationNotice: Route durations are car-profile estimates using /opt/car.lua, not live traffic ETAs.
